risk_summary: The disclosure presents favorable industry demand and company positioning but relies heavily on forward-looking, conditional language regarding macroeconomic, labor, supply-chain, pandemic, customer-spending, and goodwill-impairment risks. Quantification is limited relative to the breadth of risks, although selected figures such as $40 billion of infrastructure funding and $5.7 million of goodwill provide some specificity.
